metadata.first_call_definition: First simulate on a fresh CoPylot/GpuContext. Backend probe and process runtime initialization recorded separately; not a cold CUDA process.
metadata.monitoring: Stable idle preflight; exact owned GPU process; <=4096 MiB after context creation; <80 C and no thermal slowdown; no concurrent server jobs.
metadata.simulate_wall_definition: perf_counter around public simulate including its profiling/timing CSV writes; all extraction/parsing/telemetry outside this interval
metadata.baseline_label: Final profile with independent event warmup
metadata.first_call_caveat: Fresh prepared CoPylot context in an already initialized process; mode order can prime modules. Do not derive cold-process first-call speedups. Direct image first-use cases use independent child processes.
metadata.direct_statistics_units: Every cuda_statistics value is in seconds, including keys inherited with an _ms suffix. Raw cuda_samples retain their explicit _ms or _s units.
